replies.question: Why was Inamo killed?

Full answer
Inamo — Reason:
The sources give different accounts; no single explanation is established here.
Inamo — The Codex of Ultima Wisdom:
Not in this guide — from outside research: The Ultima Codex's Inamo article says Inamo was likely an unexpected bystander when he was killed.

Christopher — The Codex of Ultima Wisdom:
Not in this guide — from outside research: The Ultima Codex's Christopher article says Inamo was killed apparently so that he could not witness the crime.

replies.question: What is the method for the Remastered SCM Map?
replies.text:
GUIDE
Full answer
Remastered SCM Map — Method:
Ensure StarCraft Remastered is installed and updated.; Download the BWAPI integrated SCM map archive from Proton Drive or Direct Download.; Extract the downloaded ZIP file to your StarCraft maps folder (typically Documents\StarCraft\Maps).; Launch StarCraft Remastered.; Navigate to Single Player → Custom Game.; Select the extracted BWAPI map.; Crucial Step: Under Game Type, you MUST select "Use Map Settings". The AI will not function properly in a standard Melee game.; Start the game and enjoy playing against the advanced AI!
Source: existing guide; extracted. guides/StarcraftBWAPI.html — #remastered-setup ol
